notes_zh:
- **修复** macOS 26 上快捷面板关闭（Esc / 再次按快捷键）明显卡顿约半秒的问题；粘贴出字和重新打开面板的响应速度也随之变快
- **修复** 一次复制多张图片时，标题和预览只显示第一张的问题
- **修复** 图片瀑布流中多图条目显示为灰色占位块的问题
- **修复** 点击面板外部关闭时偶发的窗口闪烁，以及焦点被拉回旧应用而不是落在所点应用的问题
- **修复** ⌘回车粘贴、粘贴图片、粘贴纯文本、粘贴 OCR 文字、保存到文件夹等操作后，条目不会回到「全部」第一条的问题
- **修复** 重新打开快捷面板的瞬间恰好有新复制内容到达时，预览区与列表第一条不一致的问题
- **修复** 切换分类后移动选择时，第一条的高亮不消失的问题
- **修复** 点击分类标签时窗口轻微晃动的问题
- **修复** 繁体中文、日语、韩语、俄语等语言中 100+ 条未翻译的界面文案
- **优化** 设置窗口全新布局：原生悬浮侧边栏（macOS 26 上呈现玻璃质感），窗口支持调整大小并记住位置
- **优化** 设置分类重组：「偏好」更名为「快捷面板」；「链接预览」与「OCR」合并为「预览与识别」；「语言」与「剪贴板监听」移至「通用」
- **优化** 瀑布流键盘导航：←→ 切换分类，↓ 进入图片选择，第一行按 ↑ 返回分类
- **优化** 窄窗口下用 Tab/方向键切换分类时，选中的分类标签自动滚动到可见区域
- **优化** ⌘K 快捷操作菜单换用更通透的材质背景
notes_en:
- **Fix** Quick Panel taking ~0.5s to close (Esc / hotkey toggle) on macOS 26; pasting and reopening the panel feel snappier as well
- **Fix** Title and preview showing only the first image when multiple images are copied at once
- **Fix** Multi-image entries rendering as gray placeholder blocks in the image grid
- **Fix** Occasional window flicker when dismissing the panel by clicking outside, and focus being pulled back to the previous app instead of the one you clicked
- **Fix** Items not moving to the top of "All" after ⌘Enter paste, image paste, plain-text paste, OCR-text paste, or save-to-folder (previously only Enter paste did)
- **Fix** Preview pane and the first list row disagreeing when new content arrives at the exact moment the panel reopens
- **Fix** First row's highlight not clearing when moving the selection after switching filters
- **Fix** Slight window jiggle when clicking filter tabs
- **Fix** 100+ untranslated UI strings in Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian
- **Improve** Redesigned Settings window: native floating sidebar (glass look on macOS 26), resizable window that remembers its position
- **Improve** Settings reorganized: "Preferences" renamed to "Quick Paste"; "Link Preview" and "OCR" merged into "Preview & Recognition"; language and clipboard monitoring moved to "General"
- **Improve** Image grid keyboard navigation: ←/→ switch filters, ↓ enters the grid, ↑ on the first row returns to the filter bar
- **Improve** In narrow windows, switching filters via Tab/arrow keys now auto-scrolls the selected tab into view
- **Improve** The ⌘K command palette uses a more translucent material background
